modelNotes: Assists Board 1.0 uses season assists, last 5 assists, last 10 assists, expected minutes, minutes confidence, usage, position role, and recent assist trend.
Assists Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent assist rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Nembhard (hip) is questionable for Wednesday's game against Houston.
injury.detail: Nembhard is looking to end a one-game absence Wednesday with a hip injury. Another absence for Nembhard would likely result in a second consecutive start at point guard for Quenton Jackson, who tallied a season-high eight assists his last time out versus the 76ers.

injury.shortComment: Green is questionable for Wednesday's game in Dallas due to inflammation in his right elbow.
injury.detail: Wednesday's game will be the first of a back-to-back set, so there's a chance Green could get hit with a maintenance day. If he is forced to the sidelines, Gui Santos would have a chance to start, and Georges Niang would have the chance for a bump in minutes.

injury.shortComment: Reaves (heel) is out for Tuesday's game against the Hornets, Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com reports.
injury.detail: Reaves will miss a second consecutive matchup while tending to a bruised left heel. Quentin Grimes, Collin Sexton and Ziaire Williams should continue to see more minutes in Reaves' absence. His next opportunity to return will arrive Wednesday against Utah.

injury.shortComment: Thompson (knee) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Pacers.
injury.detail: Thompson is looking to end a one-game absence Wednesday due to a knee issue. Reed Sheppard has a chance to play a considerable role off the bench if Thompson sits out.

injury.shortComment: Adebayo (hip) is probable for Wednesday's game against the Bucks, per Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel.
injury.detail: The star big man was pulled as a precaution Monday against Houston due to a hip issue, and he's not expected to miss more time. After scoring in double figures in nine consecutive appearances prior to Monday's abbreviated outing, Adebayo will be aiming to start a new double-digit points streak Wednesday.

injury.shortComment: McConnell (hamstring) is probable to play Wednesday against the Rockets.
injury.detail: McConnell's minutes have been steadily ramping up since he made his regular-season debut on Nov. 7, and he had his best game yet in Sunday's 131-124 loss to the 76ers, finishing with 12 points, five rebounds, five assists and one steal in 19 minutes off the bench. As long as Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring) is sidelined, McConnell should be able to earn enough minutes to provide some low-end value in fantasy leagues with his output in assists and steals.

injury.shortComment: Clayton (ankle) is listed as probable for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.
injury.detail: Clayton has only missed one game this season, and that's not expected to change Wednesday versus Golden State. The 23-year-old is coming off a strong showing, amassing 13 points, four rebounds, three assists and one steal in Sunday's 131-94 loss to Boston. Clayton also logged 23 minutes, though he might not play as much Wednesday with Kyrie Irving (knee) off the injury report.

injury.shortComment: Head coach JJ Redick said he expects Walker (leg) to be available for Wednesday's game against the Jazz, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.
injury.detail: Walker won't play Tuesday against the Hornets due to some minor soreness in his right leg, but he'll return for the second leg of the back-to-back set Wednesday. Sandro Mamukelashvili, Jarred Vanderbilt and Kevon Looney will pick up the slack in his absence.

injury.shortComment: Hunter (hip) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Suns, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
injury.detail: Hunter missed Sunday's 125-103 loss to Oklahoma City due to left hip soreness, and that same issue has earned him a questionable tag versus Phoenix. If he's unable to suit up, Leaky Black, Emanuel Sharp, Keegan Murray and Malik Monk will continue to get more burn.

injury.shortComment: Watson (back) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against Memphis.
injury.detail: Watson is listed on the injury report with a low back contusion after taking a hard fall in Monday's win over the Bulls. With Jaylon Tyson (ankle) doubtful to play Wednesday, Tyrese Proctor, Mario Hezonja and Meleek Thomas could all see increased playing time if Watson is ruled out.

injury.shortComment: Tyson (ankle) is listed as doubtful for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.
injury.detail: Tyson is expected to miss a second consecutive contest with a right ankle injury. If Peyton Watson (back), who is listed as questionable, and Tyson are both ruled out, Meleek Thomas, Tyrese Proctor and Mario Hezonja could all see increased burn.

injury.shortComment: Horford (back) is questionable for Wednesday's game against Dallas.
injury.detail: The 40-year-old big man could receive some load management for the first half of this back-to-back set. Charles Bassey could be a decent streaming option in fantasy leagues if Horford sits out.

injury.shortComment: Williams (finger) is listed as probable for Wednesday's game against Brooklyn.
injury.detail: After suffering a dislocated right pinky finger in Monday's loss to the Cavaliers, Williams is expected to play Wednesday. The 25-year-old forward is averaging 7.8 points, 3.2 rebounds, 2.0 assists and 0.8 steals across 22.7 minutes per contest in six regular-season appearances.

injury.shortComment: Hayes (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Clippers.
injury.detail: Hayes will miss a second consecutive game due to a left knee strain, with his next chance to suit up coming Wednesday in the second half of the Jazz's back-to-back set. Mo Bamba is likely to remain in the starting lineup after faring well in his first start Sunday. On the year, Hayes is averaging 8.8 points, 6.0 rebounds, 1.6 assists and 1.3 blocks across 12 appearances (10 starts).

injury.shortComment: Achiuwa (ankle) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Suns, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
injury.detail: Achiuwa has missed the past two games for the Kings, but he was able to get through Tuesday's practice, so maybe he'll be able to return for Wednesday's game. If he is cleared to play, Dylan Cardwell's minutes might dip.

injury.shortComment: Holland is out for Tuesday's game against San Antonio due to a left knee contusion.
injury.detail: It's not clear as to when Holland picked up the injury, but it's significant enough to shut him down for at least one game. His next opportunity to return will arrive Wednesday in New Orleans.

injury.shortComment: Gardner (hamstring) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Bucks, per Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel.
injury.detail: Gardner is battling a hamstring injury ahead of Wednesday's action. With Pelle Larsson (illness) available, Gardner's short-term fantasy appeal appears to be expiring.

injury.shortComment: Aldama (ankle) is probable for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.
injury.detail: Aldama practiced fully Tuesday and should be able to play through an ankle sprain Wednesday. He's set to return from a one-game absence, which could result in fewer minutes for Morez Johnson.

injury.shortComment: Jovic (illness) is listed as probable for Wednesday's game against Milwaukee, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
injury.detail: Jovic is trending in the right direction following a one-game absence due to an illness. However, his return wouldn't cause any significant waves in the rotation.

injury.shortComment: Christie (ankle) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.
injury.detail: It's worth noting that Christie was a full practice participant Tuesday. His return from a two-game absence with an ankle sprain would likely lead to less playing time for Naji Marshall and Zaccharie Risacher on the wing.

injury.shortComment: Prince (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Spurs.
injury.detail: Prince made just his third appearance of the season during Saturday's 137-117 loss to Miami, finishing with two points (1-3 FG, 0-1 3Pt) and one assists in eight minutes. However, he'll now miss his 10th overall outing as he deals with soreness in his right knee. Prince's absence shouldn't have an impact on the rotation, and his next chance to suit up will come Wednesday versus New Orleans.

injury.shortComment: Lawal is doubtful for Wednesday's game against the Warriors due to tightness in his right groin.
injury.detail: Lawal is on track to sit out Wednesday's game. However, he's not a consistent part of the rotation, so his absence from the active roster won't impact fantasy leagues.

injury.shortComment: Okpara (illness) is available for Friday's game against Toronto.
injury.detail: Okpara will shed his questionable tag due to an illness and suit up Friday. However, the two-way player isn't guaranteed to see the floor.
